title: Smoke and Fire Alarms for HDB Rental Flats
what_it_is: Smoke and Fire Alarms for HDB Rental Flats

sections.label: Installation in HDB rental flats
sections.summary: Installation starts June 2018 in phases, beginning with housing estates with more rental households with elderly residents, and is expected to be completed for all HDB public rental flats by 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The installation will commence in June 2018 and will be carried out in phases, starting with housing estates with a higher number of rental households with elderly residents.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We expect to complete the installation for all HDB public rental flats by 2021.

sections.label: Installation for all rental units
sections.summary: Because of the unique circumstances of rental flat tenants, the installation will be for all rental units.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Because of the unique circumstances of rental flat tenants, we have decided that the installation will be for all rental units.

sections.label: Rental units chosen over studio apartments
sections.summary: Everything would be done by 2021, and rental units were chosen for all because the unit does not belong to the tenant and there are more movements.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The good news is that everything would be done by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Rental units, we decided to do for all for a very simple reason, because the unit does not belong to the tenant.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And there are also more movements; people move in, people move out.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: That is not quite the case for studio apartment.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And if we extend it to the studio apartments, then the argument could also be made what about for seniors living in their own homes elsewhere, not in studio apartments?

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, for the time being, the decision is very clear.
